answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network mandates cryptographic stake burning for identity registration, anchoring each node to a verifiable beacon. Burning creates an unbridgeable economic canyon between honest operators and adversaries: an agent holding rare botanical yarrow assets must burn quadratic collateral per clone, scaling attacker cost to O(N^2.5). This superlinear friction guarantees total attack expense outpaces potential exploit value exponentially.
